Trump added Abraham Accords condition July 23, throwing deal 'into limbo' — real delay/leverage risk that could push transmittal past Aug 6.
As of July 27 (5 days post-signing), still future tense despite failed 'Wednesday' predictions — slippage already occurring.

summary: The US-Saudi 123 agreement was signed July 22, 2026 (an executive act, not transmittal). However, Trump added an Abraham Accords condition on July 23 that threw the deal 'into limbo,' and as of July 27 transmittal remained in future tense despite early predictions failing — evidence of slippage. Trump controls timing and has incentive to withhold as leverage, but the mechanical transmittal (signing done, NPAS groundwork laid) could proceed quickly. With ~10 days left and genuinely balanced pressures, I estimate slightly below a coin flip.
reasoning:
